arxiv-1504-07666.title: Thermodynamics of firms’ growth
arxiv-1504-07666.creator: Eduardo Zambrano, Alberto Hernando, Aurelio Fernández-Bariviera, Ricardo Hernando, Angelo Plastino
arxiv-1504-07666.description: Abstract The distribution of firms’ growth and firms’ sizes is a topic under intense scrutiny. In this paper we show that a thermodynamic model based on the Maximum Entropy Principle, with dynamical prior information, can be constructed that adequately describes the dynamics and distribution of firms’ growth.

arxiv-2012-07384.title: Mapping Diffuse Emission in Lyman UV band
arxiv-2012-07384.creator: Li Ji, Zheng Lou, Jinlong Zhang, Keqiang Qiu, Shuangying Li, Wei Sun, Shuping Yan, Shuinai, Zhang, Yuan Qian, Sen Wang, Klaus Werner, Taotao Fang, Tinggui Wang, Jürgen Barnstedt, Sebastian Buntrock, Mingsheng Cai, Wen Chen, Lauro Conti, Lei Deng, Sebastian Diebold, Shaojun Fu, Jianhua Guo, Lars Hank
arxiv-2012-07384.description: Abstract The CAFE (Census of warm-hot intergalactic medium, Accretion, and Feedback Explorer) and LyRIC (Lyman UV Radiation from Interstellar medium and Circum-galactic medium) have been proposed to the space agencies in China respectively. CAFE was first proposed in 2015 as a joint scientific CAS-ESA small space mission.

arxiv-2106-04394.title: A note on the 2-dual space of L p ​ [ 0 , 1 ] L^{p}[0,1]
arxiv-2106-04394.creator: Akshay S. RANE
arxiv-2106-04394.description: Abstract In the present note, we are interested in bounded 2-functionals and 2-dual spaces of L p ​ [ 0 , 1 ] L^{p}[0,1] . The 2-dual spaces of the sequence space l p l^{p} is considered in the literature.

arxiv-2201-11657.title: LAGOON: An Analysis Tool for Open Source Communities Conference: MSR ’22: Proceedings of the 19th International Conference on Mining Software Repositories; May 23–24, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA CCS: Information systems Graph-based database models CCS: Human-centered computing Open source software CCS
arxiv-2201-11657.creator: Sourya Dey, Walt Woods
arxiv-2201-11657.description: Abstract . This paper presents LAGOON – an open source platform for understanding the complex ecosystems of Open Source Software (OSS) communities. The platform currently utilizes spatiotemporal graphs to store and investigate the artifacts produced by these communities, and help analysts identify bad actors who might compromise an OSS project’s security.

arxiv-2203-06699.title: Entanglement entropy in a four-dimensional cosmological background
arxiv-2203-06699.creator: V. Giantsos, N. Tetradis
arxiv-2203-06699.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by V. Giantsos, N. Tetradis. We compute the holographic entanglement entropy of a thermalized CFT on a time-dependent background in four dimensions. We consider a slab configuration extending beyond the cosmological horizon of a Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker metric. We identify a volume term that corresponds to the thermal entropy of the CFT, as well as terms proportional to the proper area of the entangling surface which are associated with strongly entangled degrees of freedom in the vicinity of this surface or with the expansion.

arxiv-2303-11786.title: Skeleton Regression: A Graph-Based Approach to Estimation with Manifold Structure
arxiv-2303-11786.creator: Zeyu Wei, Yen-Chi Chen
arxiv-2303-11786.description: Abstract We introduce a new regression framework designed to deal with large-scale, complex data that lies around a low-dimensional manifold with noises. Our approach first constructs a graph representation, referred to as the skeleton , to capture the underlying geometric structure.

arxiv-2403-07207.title: Tracking Dynamic Gaussian Density with a Theoretically Optimal Sliding Window Approach
arxiv-2403-07207.creator: Yinsong Wang, Yu Ding, Shahin Shahrampour
arxiv-2403-07207.description: Abstract Dynamic density estimation is ubiquitous in many applications, including computer vision and signal processing. One popular method to tackle this problem is the "sliding window" kernel density estimator. There exist various implementations of this method that use heuristically defined weight sequences for the observed data.

arxiv-2405-11332.title: First Order Linear Proportional Difference Equation with Integration Factor the ( s , t ) (s,t) -Pantograph Function
arxiv-2405-11332.creator: Ronald Orozco López
arxiv-2405-11332.description: Abstract In this paper we find solutions to first-order linear proportional difference equations via the ( s , t ) (s,t) -integration factor method. The ( s , t ) (s,t) -integration factor involves the ( s , t ) (s,t) -Pantograph function, which is a generalization of the partial Theta function.

arxiv-2406-14989.title: Inhomogeneous adiabatic preparation of a quantum critical ground state in two dimensions
arxiv-2406-14989.creator: Ihor Sokolov, Francis A. Bayocboc Jr, Marek M. Rams, Jacek Dziarmaga
arxiv-2406-14989.description: Abstract Adiabatic preparation of a critical ground state is hampered by the closing of its energy gap as the system size increases. However, this gap is directly relevant only for a uniform ramp, where a control parameter in the Hamiltonian is tuned uniformly in space towards the quantum critical point.

arxiv-2412-08925.title: Generalized CV Conjecture and Krylov Complexity in Two-Mode Hermitian Systems via Information Geometry
arxiv-2412-08925.creator: Ke-Hong Zhai, Lei-Hua Liu, Hai-Qing Zhang
arxiv-2412-08925.description: Abstract We extend the “complexity=volume” (CV) conjecture [ 1 ] to quantum states of two-mode Hermitian systems using the framework of information geometry. Specifically, we conjecture that the Krylov complexity of a quantum state equals the volume of the Fubini-Study metric. To test this conjecture, we construct the wave functions for both closed and open two-mode systems.

arxiv-2504-21379.title: Non-parametric multiple change-point detection
arxiv-2504-21379.creator: Andreas Anastasiou, Piotr Fryzlewicz
arxiv-2504-21379.description: Abstract We introduce a methodology, labelled Non-Parametric Isolate-Detect (NPID), for the consistent estimation of the number and locations of multiple change-points in a non-parametric setting. The method can handle general distributional changes and is based on an isolation technique preventing the consideration of intervals that contain more than one change-point, which enhances the estimation accuracy.

arxiv-2508-15538.title: Chow polynomials of simplicial posets with positive h h -vector are real-rooted
arxiv-2508-15538.creator: Elena Hoster, Christian Stump
arxiv-2508-15538.description: Abstract . We prove that a finite graded simplicial poset with a top element added has real-rooted Chow and augmented Chow polynomials whenever it has a positive h h -vector. This class of posets include Cohen-Macaulay simplicial posets and in particular lattices of flats of uniform matroids. 1. Main Results Let P be a finite graded simplicial poset.

arxiv-2509-18240.title: Revisiting galaxy cluster scaling relations through dark matter-gas coherence: scatter dependence on dynamical state.
arxiv-2509-18240.creator: Giulia Cerini, Elena Bellomi, Nico Cappelluti, Sabina Khizroev, Erwin T. Lau, Priyamvada Natarajan, John ZuHone
arxiv-2509-18240.description: Abstract Galaxy clusters, the most massive, dark matter dominated and most recently assembled structures in the Universe are key tools for probing cosmology. However, uncertainties in scaling relations that connect cluster mass to observables like X-ray luminosity and temperature remain a significant challenge.

arxiv-2509-21257.title: Hallucination as an Upper Bound: A New Perspective on Text-to-Image Evaluation
arxiv-2509-21257.creator: Seyed Amir Kasaei, Mohammad Hossein Rohban
arxiv-2509-21257.description: Abstract In language and vision–language models, hallucination is broadly understood as content generated from a model’s prior knowledge or biases rather than from the given input. While this phenomenon has been studied in those domains, it has not been clearly framed for text-to-image (T2I) generative models.

arxiv-2512-06153.title: Group graded algebras and varieties with quadratic codimension growth Thanks: E-mail addresses: quaresmawesley@gmail.com Thanks: 1 Partially supported by FAPESP
arxiv-2512-06153.creator: Wesley Quaresma Cota 1
arxiv-2512-06153.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wesley Quaresma Cota 1. Let A A be an associative algebra graded by a finite group G G over a field F {F} of characteristic zero. One associates to A A the sequence of G G -graded codimensions c n G ​ ( A ) c_{n}^{G}(A) , n = 1 , 2 , … n=1,2,\ldots , which measures the growth of the polynomial identities satisfied by A A . It is known that this sequence is either polynomially bounded or grows exponentially.

arxiv-2601-16379.title: Ab Initio Many Body Quantum Embedding and Local Correlation in Crystalline Materials using Interpolative Separable Density Fitting
arxiv-2601-16379.creator: Junjie Yang, Ning Zhang, Shunyue Yuan, Jincheng Yu, Hong-Zhou Ye, Garnet Chan
arxiv-2601-16379.description: Abstract We present an efficient implementation of ab initio many-body quantum embedding and local correlation methods for infinite periodic systems through translational symmetry adapted interpolative separable density fitting, an approach which reduces the scaling of the calculations to only linear with the number of k-points.

arxiv-2602-12440.title: Magnetotransport Spectroscopy of Strongly Rashba-Split Hole Subbands Reveals Many-Body Interactions
arxiv-2602-12440.creator: F. Sfigakis, N. A. Cockton, M. Korkusinski, S. R. Harrigan, G. Nichols, Z. D. Merino, T. Zou, A. C. Coschizza, T. Joshi, A. Shetty, M. C. Tam, Z. R. Wasilewski, S. A. Studenikin, D. G. Austing, J. B. Kycia, J. Baugh
arxiv-2602-12440.description: Abstract We report the results of magnetotransport experiments carried out on low-disorder 2D hole gases (2DHG) in the strongly correlated liquid regime, hosted in dopant-free (100) GaAs/AlGaAs single heterojunctions. Over a wide range of 2DHG densities (from 0.7 × 10 15 0.

britannica-1911-solemn.title: Solemn (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-solemn.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-solemn.description: Article 'Solemn' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. yearly, annual; from sollus=totus, whole, entire, Gr. ὄλος and annus, year), properly that which occurs annually, hence at stated intervals, regular, established; the term being particularly used of religious rites or ceremonies which recur at stated intervals, hence festive, sacred, marked by religious ceremony or ritual, and so grave, impressive, serious, the most general current usage.

pmc-10619241.title: Immune characteristics analysis and construction of a four-gene prognostic signature for lung adenocarcinoma based on estrogen reactivity
pmc-10619241.creator: Yangwei Wang, Tong Yu, Jiaping Chen, Rong Zhao, Mingxin Diao, Peiyuan Mei, Shiwen He, Wenlin Qiu, Guanchao Ye, Lijuan Jiang, Han Xiao, Yongde Liao
pmc-10619241.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is a common type of malignant tumor with poor prognosis and high mortality. In our previous studies, we found that estrogen is an important risk factor for LUAD, and different estrogen statuses can predict different prognoses. Therefore, in this study, we constructed a prognostic signature related to estrogen reactivity to determine the relationship between different estrogen reactivities and prognosis.

pmc-11474751.title: Is cardiovascular risk profiling from UK Biobank retinal images using explicit deep learning estimates of traditional risk factors equivalent to actual risk measurements? A prospective cohort study design
pmc-11474751.creator: Yiming Qian, Liangzhi Li, Yuta Nakashima, Hajime Nagahara, Kohji Nishida, Ryo Kawasaki
pmc-11474751.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). AbstractObjectiveDespite extensive exploration of potential biomarkers of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) derived from retinal images, it remains unclear how retinal images contribute to CVD risk profiling and how the results can inform lifestyle modifications.

pmc-11585028.title: Keller and Interphalangeal Joint Resection Arthroplasties for Chronic Noncomplicated Diabetic Ulcers of the Hallux: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-11585028.creator: Kaissar Yammine, Joseph Mouawad, Mohammad Omar Honeine, Chahine Assi
pmc-11585028.description: Background:Surgery is often needed for resistant plantar diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) of the big toe. For noninfected ulcers, 2 types of surgery are available: the Keller and the hallux interphalangeal joint arthroplasty (HIPJ-A) procedures. Yet, no evidence synthesis on the outcomes of these procedures has been conducted; thus, this systematic review is an attempt to fill this gap.

pmc-11688758.title: USC ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE AND ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE-RELATED DEMENTIAS (RCMAR) CENTER: LESSONS LEARNED
pmc-11688758.creator: Jennifer Ailshire
pmc-11688758.description: The National Institute on Aging has awarded another five-year, $3.6M grant to fund the University of Southern California Alzheimer’s Disease and Alzheimer’s Disease-Related Dementias Resource Center for Minority Aging Research. The Center is led by the multidisciplinary team of Julie Zissimopoulos, Jennifer Ailshire, and Emma Aguila.

pmc-12433234.title: Targeting Eosinophils in Asthmatic Inflammation: Benefits and Drawbacks
pmc-12433234.creator: David Broide
pmc-12433234.description: Asthma is associated with eosinophilic airway inflammation which contributes to poor asthma outcomes in a subset of severe asthmatics. This review traces the scientific rationale as well as the clinical development of novel therapeutics to target either IL-5 or the IL-5α receptor to deplete eosinophils from the airway to improve asthma outcomes in severe asthma with eosinophilic airway inflammation.

pmc-12628900.title: Supporting community integration and wellbeing after relocation among older adults living alone: a study protocol for the welcome project in Japan
pmc-12628900.creator: Mari Yamashita, Ayako Edahiro, Mariko Nishi, Mutsuko Okamura, Yukiko Kugimiya, Hana Sakurai, Nobuko Nagano, Kae Ito, Tsuyoshi Okamura
pmc-12628900.description: BackgroundJapan’s population is aging rapidly, and the proportion of older adults living alone is increasing. Some older adults relocate owing to aging housing, health issues, or financial difficulties. In certain cases, they move closer to adult children to improve access to support—referred to in Japan as yobiyose.

pmc-12664067.title: Analysis of the impact of irradiance and temperature on photovoltaic production: A statistical and machine learning approach
pmc-12664067.creator: El Hadji Mbaye Ndiaye, Alphousseyni Ndiaye, Mactar Faye, Daouda Gueye, Amadou Ba, Mamadou Traore
pmc-12664067.description: This study explores the influence of solar irradiance (Ir) and ambient temperature (T) on photovoltaic (PV) production (P) by combining statistical analysis and deep learning techniques. A strong positive correlation was found between irradiance and PV output with Pearson coefficient (R=0.9211), while temperature exhibited a moderate effect (R=0.4477).

pmc-13049403.title: Vanishing bone metastasis in pediatric mediastinal lymphoma: A diagnostic pitfall on contrast-enhanced computed tomography
pmc-13049403.creator: Bouanane Rania, Belkouchi Lina, Taibi Ouiam, Allali Nazik, Chat Latifa, El haddad Sihame
pmc-13049403.description: Vanishing bone metastasis (VBM), a reversible pseudopathologic vertebral enhancement related to vertebral venous congestion, is an imaging pitfall that can mimic true osseous metastases in patients with thoracic venous obstruction. We report a rare pediatric case involving a 15-year-old boy with mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma who presented with superior vena cava obstruction.

pmc-13407188.title: Pediatric acute leukemia mimicking osteomyelitis: clinical and MRI features
pmc-13407188.creator: Stefano Malvestiti, Edoardo Muratore, Simon Wiedemann, Kristin Goller-Bruchmann, Michelangelo Baldazzi, Tamara Abdul-Nour, Brigitte Strahm, Roland Elling, Christian Flotho, Tobias Feuchtinger
pmc-13407188.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPediatric acute leukemia (AL) typically presents with symptoms of cytopenias, organomegaly, and fever. In some instances, however, musculoskeletal pain may be the predominant—occasionally the sole—initial symptom, leading to misdiagnoses such as osteomyelitis.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective, multicenter, observational, cohort study including children and adolescents (<18 years) diagnosed with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) or acute myeloid leukemia (AML) between 2017 and 2024 who initially presented with osteomyelitis-like clinical and/or radiological features.

pmc-13457592.title: Nur77 agonism invigorates Natural Killer cell immunity against hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13457592.creator: Shi Yong Neo, Yu Mei, Joni Chong, Kang Yi Lee, Jyue Yuan Lim, Menaka P Rajapakse, Timothy Wai Ho Shuen, Junzhe Zhao, Le Tong, Tasneem Kajiji, Hui Shi Cheong, Charis Toh, Zhen Wei Neo, Li Yen Chong, Wei Lin Tang, Nicholas Ang, Alicia Tay, Xinsong Chen, Hartman Johan, Shanshan Wu Howland, Joe Poh Shen
pmc-13457592.description: Despite promising development as emerging “off-the-shelf” therapeutics against cancer, natural killer (NK) cells still faced considerable challenges in the solid tumor microenvironment (TME), including poor penetrance and immuno-suppression. Here, we employ spatial and single-cell transcriptomics to reveal a role for Nur77 in NK cell-mediated immunity against hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
